text: S663 starts a read-only source-geometry coverage study of recipe-declared grainlines across S459's seven-recipe/73-configuration M matrix. It will check every resolved line against its own current CUT polygon. This may establish whether S662's additive proposal can generalize from Polo; it does not select or implement a profile, write a DXF, or interact with DGS. Preserve every V03 gate and all holds. See the S663 start packet.
